_meta.description: Heart event #2 for npc_michelle: The Quiet Evening

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [You find Michelle reading alone in the clinic after hours]

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: Oh! Jack! I didn't expect — the clinic's closed, but you can stay.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: I was reading an Old World medical text. The things they could do...

options.text: You read a lot. What drives you?

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: They could mend bones in hours. Cure diseases we can barely name.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: I want to help people that much. I just... don't know if I'm good enough.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: Sorry. That's too much. You came here to... why DID you come here?

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: ...To see me? Oh. That's... that's nice. Thank you.
